TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In view of a General Meeting at CM Residence, 8 Raj Niwas Marg, on 21.11.2025 (Friday), traffic movement is expected to remain slow between 08:00 AM and 12:00 PM.

📍 AFFECTED ROUTES (08:00 AM – 12:00 PM):
Shamnath Marg, Rajpur Road, Rajniwas Marg, Chauburja Marg

📍 DIVERSION POINTS (As Required):
Shamnath Marg RL → IP College RL
MCD Chowk → Tis Hazari Courts
Khoya Mandi U-turn → Outer Ring Road
Civil Lines RL → IP College RL (for Shamnath Marg)

📍 PARKING ADVISORY:
No roadside parking on affected stretches.
Unauthorised vehicles may be towed/prosecuted.

📍 COMMUTER ADVISORY:
Avoid these roads during the advisory period.
Use alternate routes & follow directions of traffic staff.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

The Hon’ble President of India will be visiting Hyderabad on 21 and 22 November 2025. Due to VIP movement to Rashtrapati Nilayam and Raj Bhavan, some areas in Secunderabad, Trimulgherry, and Begumpet may experience temporary traffic stops or diversions.
Citizens are requested to plan their travel accordingly.
